narration.text: You're mowing. A customer wants a quote.
But you can't stop every job to answer messages.
VividScales helps keep those conversations moving.
Respond to inquiries, collect job details, and keep it all organized.
And follow up on estimates, so a busy day doesn't mean a forgotten conversation.
Focus on the work. Stay on top of inquiries.
